purpose: Lawful normalized facts captured for deterministic Phase 7B feasibility replay. This fixture contains no applicant data and is not production evidence.

sources.publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs
sources.technical_access: stable HTML index plus predictable country/category pages; normalized manual capture required
sources.freshness: country pages observed with 2025 updates; review before every evidence release
sources.replay: captured normalized route facts, exact page URLs, effective dates and checksums; never browse at runtime
sources.limitations: Practical guidance is not authentic legal text; member states decide applications and national conditions. Denmark and Ireland are outside the common legal-migration directives.

sources.publisher: Australian Government Department of Home Affairs
sources.technical_access: stable HTML route pages; normalized manual capture required
sources.freshness: review before every evidence release and on route-change alerts
sources.replay: captured normalized route facts and exact page identities
sources.limitations: Website is a basic guide; legislation is authoritative and route decisions remain individual.

sources.technical_access: stable HTML route pages; normalized manual capture required
sources.freshness: review before every evidence release and on IRCC change notices
sources.replay: captured normalized route facts and exact page identities
sources.limitations: Invitation, program, permit and family-work conditions are conditional and time-varying.

sources.technical_access: stable HTML rules and guidance with update history; normalized manual capture required
sources.freshness: rules observed updated 2026-07-01; review before every evidence release
sources.replay: captured normalized rule facts, exact URLs and effective dates
sources.limitations: Route matching is conditional; the public check cannot predict sponsorship, discretion or grant.

sources.technical_access: HTML and official PDF guidance; normalized manual capture required
sources.freshness: review before every evidence release and on USCIS policy alerts
sources.replay: captured normalized route facts and exact asset identities
sources.limitations: H-1B, H-4 and OPT have petition, cap, authorization and status conditions; third-party material is excluded.

sources.technical_access: stable HTML summary plus linked legislation
sources.freshness: review before every evidence release; revision proposal is active
sources.replay: normalized summary can replay, but complete national pathway inventories are not captured
sources.limitations: Five-year EU long-term-resident summary does not cover complete national settlement pathways or applicant residence histories.

sources.technical_access: interactive database; no stable versioned bulk export established
sources.replay: not yet sufficient for complete regulator/profession/jurisdiction replay
sources.limitations: Coverage identifies regulated professions and authorities, not a complete normalized licensing decision rule.

sources.technical_access: publication tables and interactive calculator; underlying TaxBEN STATA command requires application/review
sources.replay: fixed OECD household benchmarks replay; arbitrary applicant gross-to-net formulas do not
sources.limitations: Eight standardized household types and earnings levels are not an arbitrary taxpayer calculator.

sources.technical_access: free JSON-stat dissemination API; latest-version endpoint updated twice daily
sources.freshness: captured metadata update 2026-01-07 with 2024 and 2025 periods
sources.replay: normalized metadata and representative rows are captured; production would retain each raw response checksum because API history is not versioned
sources.limitations: Selected reference-city neighbourhood rents for standardized dwellings, designed for remuneration comparisons, are not national housing-market estimates.

sources.technical_access: structured comparative tables and country information; normalized extraction requires review
sources.freshness: updated twice yearly, January and July
sources.replay: system eligibility summaries can be captured; a comparable applicant mandatory-cost formula cannot yet replay
sources.limitations: Healthcare-system descriptions do not supply a comparable, applicant-specific mandatory-cost calculation.

candidate_overrides.public_limitations: Positive or conditional matches only across the frozen named-route inventory; never predicts invitation, sponsorship or grant.

candidate_overrides.public_name: Dependants on supported work and study routes
candidate_overrides.public_limitations: Limited to partner/child conditions attached to the frozen supported primary routes; not a general family-reunification checker.

candidate_overrides.public_name: Post-study stay and work route check
candidate_overrides.public_limitations: Checks current/completed study facts against frozen routes; future graduation remains provisional and institution identity must be verified.
Current sources do not form a complete route inventory or normalize residence-history counting.
Database coverage does not replace profession-, regulator- and jurisdiction-specific recognition rules.
OECD benchmark households cannot yield an arbitrary applicant payslip; national formulas remain required.
Reference-city standardized-dwelling rents are not representative national rents; the frozen 6-of-8-anchor floor is not met.
MISSOC describes systems but does not provide comparable mandatory-cost formulas for the supported applicant model.

route_rule_examples.destination_scope: EU portal 25, subject to national transposition
route_rule_examples.positive_boundary: A named route can be conditionally matched when its frozen threshold facts are satisfied.
route_rule_examples.negative_boundary: Absence of a positive match is not permanent ineligibility.

route_rule_examples.positive_boundary: Conditional match only; nomination and grant are external decisions.
route_rule_examples.negative_boundary: Do not infer rejection from incomplete facts.

route_rule_examples.positive_boundary: Potential program match is separate from invitation.

route_rule_examples.negative_boundary: Cap selection, petition approval, visa issuance and admission are outside the check.

metric_formula_examples.usable_for: one explicit city, dwelling type, currency and period

metric_formula_examples.blocked_for: comparable applicant mandatory-cost estimate until national formulas are captured
